newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average gains more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average gains more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average gained more than 50 points in late afternoon trading Monday, as the market attracted bargain hunters after last week's loss of nearly 135 points.
At 3:12 p.m. EDT, the Dow was up 50.58 points at 6,442.27, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading.
